description.zh:
要查询的设备名称。

><notice>
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
></notice>
description.en:
The DeviceName of the device.

>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the **ProductKey** parameter.

description.zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块的数据。
description.en:
The identifier of the custom TSL module. Each identifier is unique in a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries the data of the default module.

description.zh:
要查询属性所属的设备ID或IoT孪生节点ID：

- 调用[QueryDeviceInfo](~~QueryDeviceInfo~~)接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。
- 在物联网平台控制台的**孪生实体图**页面，单击孪生节点，可查看**节点ID**。


> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
description.en:
The ID of the device or digital twin node whose property data you want to query.

*   You can call the [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~) operation to query the **ID** of the device.
*   Log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Twin Details** page, click the digital twin node to view its **ID**.

>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters. The **IotId** parameter specifies a globally unique identifier (GUID) for the device. The value of the IotId parameter corresponds to a combination of the values of the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters. If you specify the **IotId**, **ProductKey**, and **DeviceName** parameters, the value of the **IotId** parameter takes precedence.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。


> - 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
>  - 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
>*   If no **Overview** page or instance ID appears in the console, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
要查询的设备所属的产品ProductKey。

><notice>
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the **DeviceName** parameter.

title.zh: 查询指定设备的属性快照

descriptions.zh:
若查询IoT孪生节点的属性数据，必须传入参数**IotId**，且取值为孪生节点ID。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为200。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
To query the property data of a digital twin node, you must set the **IotId** parameter to the ID of the digital twin node.

## QPS limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can run up to 200 queries per second (QPS). 

>  The RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-property-status --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --function-block-id BatteryModule --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryDevicePropertyStatus --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --FunctionBlockId BatteryModule --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
